review.reviewer: independent PH-299 period-close/forecast ADR reviewer (fresh context, read-only)
findings: BLOCKER - the frozen period state machine contradicts the merged core model: ADR 0016 defines `open -> closing -> closed -> reopened`, but the delivered `core.AccountingPeriod` has only `status in (active, posted)` with the CheckConstraint `(active AND closed_through IS NULL) OR (posted AND closed_through IS NOT NULL)`; `closing`/`reopened` do not exist. The ADR acknowledges the active/posted fact in its background but never maps it or states the required schema/constraint migration, so an implementation of the frozen states would require a contract-changing migration/data rewrite that the ADR does not authorize or plan. Fix: either (a) freeze the existing model semantics explicitly (active=open, posted=closed) and define any `closing`/`reopened` states only as a documented future schema change with old->new mapping, migration/backfill, and constraint plan, or (b) keep the target state names but add the required canonical entity/status migration and transition mapping to PH-322's implementation prerequisites; the ADR must not silently present an incompatible state enum as existing.

OTHER CONTENT CHECKED: lock boundary uses the real `AccountingPeriod.closed_through`; close command semantics/append-only conclusion/company lock/request_token/dry_run/duplicate-close rejection are coherent; forecast batch fields (period/version/scope/status/coverage/covered/gap/source_refs/as_of), server-side coverage derivation, null+missing, append-only superseded versions and client-override rejection are frozen; cross-owner read composition is limited to PH-291/283/288/280/281/279/277/274 and does not create a second owner; role matrix/idempotency/history-read are stated.
